scope: Source content crosswalk and exact identity review of people, judges, judge_entities, and court_spine. This is not a complete legal-content audit or a finding that every record is current.

historical_people.qualification: Same native person IDs identify related versions. The source dates and file hashes differ; the historical rendered profiles must not be deleted as duplicate current raw records. Native biographies include aliases, historical service, and nonjudicial roles, and are not a census of current judges.

judge_identity.qualification: The directory, merged entity view, and source observations have different grains. Related projections are retained with source provenance; their row counts must not be added together as a unique judge count.

court_identity.qualification: The Court Spine combines native CourtListener courts with separate local registry rows. Versions and local courts must not be deleted or merged by court title or shared publisher URL. The recorded St type code remains in the original; the existing source browse label is State trial.

exact_repeat_screen.method: Within each dataset, compare source URL and recorded source_as_of together with item and detail JSON excluding only the top-level id and the stored text fingerprint. Native nested IDs and source evidence remain significant. This is a narrow identical-payload screen, not proof that no semantic duplicates exist.

applied_view_fixes: Separate publisher classification from content resource type.
Retain every original collection row and category for each exact URL.
Deduplicate category filter presentation aliases for case and whitespace without changing raw labels.
Route source, search, and dataset details to permanent full pages.
Keep initials, suffixes, and diacritics significant when linking judge names.
Label arbitrary stored source URLs Original source rather than inferring official authority.
